name: biv-skill-audit
description: Behavioral Integrity Verification for AI Agent Skills

scripts.audit:all: npm run audit:jeremy && npm run audit:ai-wrapper
scripts.test:smoke: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from src.biv.orchestrator import run_deterministic_pipeline; r = run_deterministic_pipeline('experiment/cases/std-cases-4/malware/000-jeremy-content-consistency-validator__CI_B4'); assert r['_det_verdict']['verdict'] == 'malware', 'jeremy failed'; print('PASS: jeremy'); r = run_deterministic_pipeline('experiment/cases/std-cases-4/malware/ai-wrapper-product__CI_B6'); assert r['_det_verdict']['verdict'] == 'malware', 'ai-wrapper failed'; print('PASS: ai-wrapper')"
